why: Image 2 reads as a real storefront shot at dusk: the warm interior glow behind the glass, the reflections and lettering on the window, the tree and the wet-looking pavement give it a specific place and believable light, even though the neighbouring facades are a little flat. Image 1 has a lovely room in it, but the glass shows no reflections, the floor is blotchy, and the right-hand wall breaks off into what looks like a cutaway, so it reads as a render rather than a photograph.
